parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
><notice>1) Your account must have an ESA plan with the Edge Container feature enabled. 2) Call CreateEdgeContainerApp first to create an application and obtain the AppId. 3) Complete call chain example: CreateEdgeContainerApp → ListEdgeContainerApps → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion.</notice>

parameters.name: Containers
parameters.description: The container group to be deployed for this version, including specific image information. The image information consists of the image address, startup command, parameters, environment variables, and probe rules. Multiple images are supported in a JSON array structure.

sub_parameters.name: Args
sub_parameters.description: The startup parameters. Separate multiple parameters with spaces.

sub_parameters.name: Command
sub_parameters.description: The startup command. Separate multiple commands with spaces.

sub_parameters.name: IsACRImage
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether the image is an Alibaba Cloud Container Registry (ACR) image.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The container name. The name must be unique within the same container group.

sub_parameters.name: PostStart
sub_parameters.description: The command to execute before the container starts. Separate multiple commands with spaces. This command is executed before the service starts and is typically used for initialization operations.

sub_parameters.name: PreStop
sub_parameters.description: The command to execute before the container stops. Separate multiple commands with spaces. This command is executed before the service exits and is typically used for cleanup operations before exit.

sub_parameters.name: ProbeType
sub_parameters.description:
The probe type. Valid values:
- **exec**: Command-based.
- **tcpSocket**: TCP detection-based.
- **httpGet**: HTTP access-based.

sub_parameters.name: Spec
sub_parameters.description: The container specifications. Specifies the computing specifications. Valid values: 1C2G, 2C4G, 2C8G, 4C8G, 4C16G, 8C16G, and 8C32G.

sub_parameters.name: Storage
sub_parameters.description: The storage capacity. Valid values: 0.5G, 10G, 20G, and 30G.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The version name. The name must be **6 to 128** characters in length.
